title: Grill — dynamic model & effort catalog per harness

harness-scope.title: Which harnesses get new or extended discovery in this change?
harness-scope.display: Claude Code: new `initialize` probe; Cursor: structured base + effort + fast discovery; Gemini: `gemini models -o json` on ≥ 0.67; Codex: also read `isDefault` / `defaultReasoningEffort`; Copilot: try its ACP server for models + efforts; Antigravity: no new source
harness-scope.note: We have a refresh icon button already, right? to refetch the options

curated-fate.title: What happens to the hand-curated model tables (`AGENT_OPTIONS`, `MODEL_EFFORT_SUPPORT`, `CLAUDE_MODEL_FLAG`, `CURSOR_MODEL_SPECS`…)?
curated-fate.display: Keep them, frozen: fallback + optional label/hint overlay

claude-id-scheme.title: How do claude's CLI ids map onto agetor's model ids?
claude-id-scheme.display: Keep friendly ids; derive them from CLI ids by rule
claude-id-scheme.note: Let's also beautify the names, like, opus-5.5 can become Opus 5.5.

claude-alias-rows.title: Should the picker also offer auto-tracking "latest" rows (e.g. **Opus (latest)**) that follow each family's newest release?

claude-scoping.title: Claude's list has no Mythos rows. Should curated rows the CLI doesn't list be hidden?

defaults.title: Default model and default effort: who picks them once discovery exists?
defaults.display: Owner pick stays; the CLI's default is the fallback

unknown-efforts.title: A CLI reports an effort level agetor doesn't know (e.g. cursor `extra-high`, a future codex tier). What happens?
unknown-efforts.display: Synthesize a row and pass it through

order-labels.title: Where do discovered models land in the picker, and whose label do they show?
order-labels.display: CLI order wins; curated-only rows follow

cursor-strategy.title: Cursor: where do its model families, effort levels and fast variants come from?
cursor-strategy.display: Parse the flat list into base + effort + fast

speed-tiers.title: Claude (`supportsFastMode`) and codex (`fast` service tier) report speed tiers. Do they belong in this change?

min-cli-floor.title: Retire the per-model minimum-CLI-version table (`MODEL_MIN_CLI_VERSION`) where discovery is authoritative?
min-cli-floor.display: Discovery check first; the table becomes a frozen fallback

persist-catalog.title: Should the last discovered catalog survive a restart?
persist-catalog.display: Persist in the `preferences` table, no migration

opus-46-xhigh.title: Pre-existing bug: curated Opus 4.6 offers `xhigh`, which claude says it doesn't support
opus-46-xhigh.value: Fix the curated row in this change (drop `xhigh` from `opus-4.6`), so old CLIs without discovery stop offering it too. A stored `xhigh` on existing tasks is kept (`retainableEfforts`), never PATCHed away.

claude-probe-isolation.title: Claude probe isolation and privacy
claude-probe-isolation.value: Spawn through `coreSpawn` with `--strict-mcp-config` (no MCP servers), `disableAllHooks`, `--no-session-persistence`, an empty cwd under the data dir, the harness's `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, a 10 s timeout. Parse only `models[]`; never log or store the raw response (it carries the account email and org). If build-time checks show MCP servers or hooks still start, claude stays curated and that's reported back.

probe-cadence.title: When the new probes run
probe-cadence.value: Same scheduler and triggers as today's probes: boot, harness status change, harness CRUD, manual refresh, and the 15-minute sweep. No new route or SSE stream; reuse `agent_models_changed`.

no-effort-fallback.title: A discovered model with no reported efforts and no curated row
no-effort-fallback.value: Today's fallback stays: the default model's ladder for claude (< 2.1.49) and copilot, no effort picker for gemini, antigravity and unparsed cursor rows. Haiku 4.5's curated "no effort" stays authoritative.

cursor-param-driver.title: Cursor driver keeps flat variant ids
cursor-param-driver.value: The cursor driver keeps passing flat variant ids (`grok-4.7-high-fast`), not the bracket form `base[effort=…,fast=…]`.

cursor-config-side-effect.title: Pre-existing: agetor's cursor runs may change your interactive cursor default
cursor-config-side-effect.value: Check once during the build (compare `~/.cursor/cli-config.json` before and after a run). If agetor runs do change it, record that as a separate ticket; this change only makes sure the new discovery never writes it.

copilot-unchanged.title: Copilot and antigravity keep their current probes
copilot-unchanged.value: Copilot keeps `help config` (ids) with curated efforts, and antigravity keeps `agy models`. The curated-table policy above applies to both. A copilot ACP probe becomes its own spike, unless you ticked it under Scope.

tests-acceptance.title: Acceptance bar and tests
tests-acceptance.value: Done means: a stub claude reporting a new `claude-opus-6` with its own effort ladder makes **Opus 6** appear in the New Task picker, the task editor and `agetor add`, with that ladder and no agetor change; an old/failed probe gives today's curated picker. Tests: a parser unit test per probe with redacted spike fixtures; a cross-kind invariant that no merged picker has two rows for the same CLI model or the same label (the S2 bug); `supportedEfforts` with unknown levels; one Playwright e2e on the stub claude, extending the fx stub-bin seam.

docs.title: Docs
docs.value: Update `harnesses.md` (the add-a-model / add-a-kind checklist: a new model needs no PR unless it wants a label/hint override), each touched `harness-<kind>.md`, and CLAUDE.md's "Agent kinds at a glance" probe column. Copy the goal into `docs/plans/dynamic-model-catalog.md` with the plan.
